Players Committee card image of [[Stolen Data Tapes (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on R2-D2. If about to leave table (even from Overwhelmed), relocate to Dune Sea (if possible). If at Dune Sea, may relocate to your character there. If at Alderaan (or a 'blown away' system), tapes 'delivered;' relocate this Effect to table and may take any card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/stolendatatapes_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/91ca80c51880e683322c125b7a0b6ec807df1ab8 91ca80c] (18 February 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
